# Agentic Coding Foundation

> Practical guidance for people and agents doing useful coding work. Read selectively; verify product behavior against the dated primary sources.

## Start
- [Agent entry](guide/agent-entry.md): Guided application, boundaries, and routing.
- [First task](guide/first-task.md): A beginner's first useful change.
- [Supplied practice task](examples/practice-task.md): Report fixtures, independent expected CSVs, and error/rerun cases for readers without a project.
- [Working loop](guide/workflow.md): Brief, inspect, change, verify, hand off.

## Practice
- [Context](guide/context.md): Instructions, evidence, and task state.
- [Verification](guide/verification.md): Actual behavior and evidence.
- [Recovery](guide/recovery.md): Diagnosis, undo, and resuming work.
- [Team practice](guide/team-practice.md): Ownership, review, and shared learning.
- [Advanced practice](guide/advanced.md): Skills, tools, delegation, and budgets.
- [Platform notes](guide/platforms.md): Dated operating differences.
- [Worked task](examples/worked-task.md): A synthetic workplace example.
- [Templates](templates/README.md): Briefs, instructions, handoffs, and lessons.

## Maintain
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Editorial and validation requirements.
- [Maintenance](maintenance/README.md): Weekly research and human decisions.
- [Sources](maintenance/sources.md): Claim support and research limits.
- [Learner scenarios](maintenance/learner-scenarios.md): Behavior checks for guide contributors; use after relevant teaching changes.
